entries.name: plate-detector-yolov8n
entries.license: AGPL-3.0 (model weights used per upstream terms; see registry notes)
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 640x640 BGR letterboxed; YOLOv8 license plate detection
entries.notes: Converted from joker5914/yolov8n-license-plate (Ultralytics YOLOv8). Runs via VNCoreMLRequest (object detection).

entries.name: plate-ocr-trocr-small
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 384x96 RGB plate crop; TrOCR vision-encoder-decoder
entries.notes: TrOCR-based plate OCR (transformers). Requires transformers→CoreML export path; Vision fallback used until then.

entries.name: vehicle-detector-yolov8n
entries.inputDescription: IMAGE 640x640 BGR letterboxed; YOLOv8 COCO detection heads
entries.notes: COCO vehicle classes (car, truck, bus, motorcycle) gate the fleet classifier stages; fine-tune on fleet imagery later (ROADMAP M2).

entries.name: vehicle-reid-osnet-x0_25
entries.notes: Person-ReID-trained OSNet as interim vehicle re-ID backbone; replace with VeRi-Wild-finetuned variant (ROADMAP M2).
